OR III-1 pp.154-155,157 (https://ehistory.osu.edu/books/official-records/122/0157); GO1861 GO16, 4 May, pp.36-40: additional Regular regiments directed to be raised, not a return of men actually enlisted. The minimum and maximum remain catalogue figures; actual strength is unknown, so the executable requisition keeps men:null. [I] One central recruiting post and the ordinary compliance/loyalty/muster path represent an unquantified enlistment effort; the common pack muster delay is not a sourced completion date and supplies no numerical strength. Three-year terms follow the July 29 act section 5, GO1861 p.101, expressly applying to enlistments made in 1861; retrospective term representation [I].

offensives.source: docs/research/2026-11-14-secession-winter-1861.md, 1861-07-16: McDowell marches from Washington [WIKI-Bull]; GO1861 GO26 p.61 and OR I-2 pp.59-60 identify the command. [I] Route the existing dated goal through that command; no tactical weight or battle event changes.

OR I-II p.725, Scott to Patterson, 25 June: remain before the enemy between Winchester and the Potomac; battle conditional on equal/superior force; pursuit to Winchester not enjoined. Pp.166-168, 13/17/18 July: demonstrations to detain Johnston in the valley and prevent reinforcement of Manassas. [I] Hold the existing lower_valley region as the available geographic containment goal; not an order to take Winchester or a guarantee of pinning. Ordinary planning, compliance, messages and movement decide performance.

OR I-II p.173, Scott to Patterson, 23 July, 4.15 p.m.: hold Harpers Ferry unless a well-ascertained force can expel him. [I] Later ordinary hold order; no forced arrival, outcome or extension of expiring service.

appointments.source: GO1861, General Orders 12, 27 April 1861, section 3, p.31; OR I-2 chronological summary p.1: Patterson assigned the Department of Pennsylvania, headquarters Philadelphia or where temporarily occupied. [I] Effective rule-seat appointment at daily granularity, through normal delivery; no force is created by the appointment.

GO1861 GO12, 27 April, section 4 p.31, directs C.F.Smith back to Fort Columbus to assume the superintendent duties assigned by SO80 of 15 March. [I] Effective administrative appointment on the return-to-duty direction, through the normal verb; this is not a newly invented March 15 arrival or an opening post.

OR III-1 p.204 (https://ehistory.osu.edu/books/official-records/122/0204), Saunders to Cameron, Omaha, 15 May, signed Governor of Nebraska. [I] The first read confirmed holding of office supplies the effective model appointment; the legal appointment/assumption date and the opening holder are unknown. No date-only notice installs him.

[I] effective appointment at daily granularity on assumption: Scott to Butler, 18 May 1861, Private and Official Correspondence of Gen. Benjamin F. Butler I, pp. 94-95 (Dimick retains the regular garrison); Butler to Scott, 24 May, ibid. p. 104 and OR I-2 p. 648 (arrival Wednesday at 8 a.m., 22 May). R89 maps the superior command to us_dept_virginia.

GO1861, General Orders 26, 27 May 1861, p.61, creates and assigns the department; OR I-2 chronological summary p.2 records assumption on 28 May. OR I-2 pp.59-60, McDowell report dated Arlington 1 June, supplies the headquarters. [I] Effective appointment on the assumption date, following R89; normal letter delivery decides completion.

concentrations.source: OR I-LI.1 pp397-398,406,415-416, sourced brigade regiments. S74 [I]: request identified regiments through the sender, never create a historical roster or move an arrival.

OR I-2 pp.303-309,314-315,751,754. [I] The dated McDowell department is not the whole Washington garrison or any whole statewide requisition. The model call batches have no named regiment membership, so their July command allocation remains unresolved. Keep them with their current posts; do not apply the 37,321 departmental duty total to these batches or distribute it over divisions. S74/0108: identified lots can now be requested; senders select regiments by compliance, and movement owns arrivals. [I] Shared-state requests prefer the Pennsylvania department for Pennsylvania/Wisconsin, the Washington-facing department for the other supplied states.
